gates.requirement: P0–P4 are reviewed, published in dependency order, and the P5 PR is retargeted to corrected main.
Review the actual toolbar browser-action popup in a normal unmanaged supported Chrome installation.
Keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, contrast, motion, and cognitive-usability review.
Multi-day service-worker, retention, alarm, report, and notification lifecycle review.
Review labeled real-site false positives and false negatives beyond the curated regression corpus.
Review live provider behavior, account routing, cost, retention, and response handling with a dedicated test credential.
Review real peer exchange, abuse resistance, authenticity limits, connection metadata, and provider dependencies.
Independent extension-security and privacy assessment; automated gates are insufficient.
Audit GitHub Releases, tags, Chrome Web Store drafts/listings, demos, submissions, videos, downloads, portfolio, and social copy while authenticated.
Required before making compliance claims or deploying in a regulated context.
Approve final artifact hash, release notes, limitations, known issues, and rollback plan.
